messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: ded-5xx-high — Dedicated endpoints 5xx rate > 4% for 2m. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/dedicated-5xx
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident ded-5xx-high created (INC12345). Escalation in 8m if unacked. Link: https://pd/INC12345
alice: acking (alice) — I'll take first look, oncall routing
sanjay: oncall here, pulling logs from pool-7 and runtime metrics
lloyd: any signs of customer-facing errors? katie can you check support dashboard?
katie: quick check — no incoming support tickets, SLOs show a tiny blip in 4xx->5xx but frontends show very few failed requests, likely internal retries.
alice: running aggregate query to confirm 5xx window:
```
# prometheus-ish query (approx)
sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="dedicated-runtime",code=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="dedicated-runtime"}[2m]))
```
Result ~4.6% at peak around 12:34Z
sanjay: grabbing worker logs, seeing repeated OOMs on runtime-worker-3 around same time:
```
2026-03-15T12:33:58Z runtime-worker-3 ERROR oom-killer invoked: kill process 4221 (inference) for out-of-memory
2026-03-15T12:34:02Z runtime-worker-3 INFO restarted container inference
2026-03-15T12:34:10Z runtime-worker-3 WARN backlog spike while restart
```
alice: that looks like autoscaler churn: scale-down happened, then pod killed, warmup caused transient errors. Not a model bug.
lloyd: ok — two quick mitigations: 1) scale pool up by 2 to absorb warmups, 2) temporarily relax aggressive scale-down for the pool for 15m.
sanjay: running commands now:
```
redwoodctl scale pool dedicated-pool-7 --replicas 6
redwoodctl config set pool dedicated-pool-7 autoscale.down_grace=15m
```
alice: commands applied, replicas -> 6, down_grace -> 15m. Watching metrics.
katie: seeing error rate fall already — 5xx down to ~0.6% in last 90s :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Alert ded-5xx-high auto-resolved (no new firing rules) at 3212346050 — closing PD incident if metrics remain stable.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 marked resolved by system (auto-resolve).
alice: good. minimal/no customer impact — internal retries caused most of the visible 5xxs. We'll still follow up.
lloyd: quick followup action items: file CR to tweak autoscaler policy (less aggressive scale-down for hot pools) and add synthetic canary ping during scale events. I'll own the CR.
katie: I'll open a small post-incident note in #postmortems with graphs and timeline.
sanjay: adding a short runbook note: consider increasing `down_grace` default for dedicated pools serving large models.
alice: handing off monitoring to @lloyd for 1h — please watch for any re-flares, ping me if it comes back.
lloyd: ack — I'll watch the dashboards and hold pager. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
katie: moving to follow-up tasks, marking this thread resolved.
notes: brief transient autoscaler-induced 5xx spike; auto-resolved after scaling and relaxed scale-down; low customer impact; follow-up CR + canary
